question: list in alphabetic order all course names and their instructors' names in year 2008.
failed_sql: SELECT t1.title , instructor.name FROM course AS t1 JOIN instructor AS t2 ON t1.dept_name  =  t2.dept_name WHERE t1.year  =  2008 ORDER BY t1.title , t2.name
target_sql:
SELECT c.title, i.name
FROM course AS c
JOIN section AS s ON c.course_id = s.course_id
JOIN teaches AS t ON s.course_id = t.course_id AND s.sec_id = t.sec_id AND s.semester = t.semester AND s.year = t.year
JOIN instructor AS i ON t.ID = i.ID
WHERE s.year = 2008
ORDER BY c.title, i.name

target_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(*) FROM Customers c INNER JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

question: Show the name of the shop that have the largest quantity of devices in stock.
failed_sql: SELECT Shop_Name FROM stock GROUP BY Shop_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
target_sql: SELECT s.Shop_Name FROM stock st JOIN shop s ON st.Shop_ID = s.Shop_ID GROUP BY st.Shop_ID ORDER BY SUM(st.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Show all track names that have had no races.
failed_sql: SELECT Name FROM track WHERE Seatings = 0
target_sql: SELECT t.Name FROM track t LEFT JOIN race r ON t.Track_ID = r.Track_ID WHERE r.Track_ID IS NULL

question: What are the names of device shops, and what are the carriers that they carry devices in stock for?
failed_sql: SELECT t1.shop_name ,  t2.carrier FROM stock AS t1 JOIN shop AS t2 ON t1.shop_id  =  t2.shop_id
target_sql:
SELECT s.shop_name, d.carrier
FROM stock t1
JOIN shop s ON t1.shop_id = s.shop_id
JOIN device d ON t1.device_id = d.device_id

question: What is the total account balance for customers with a credit score of above 100 for the different states?
failed_sql: SELECT sum(acc_bal) ,  T2.state FROM customer AS T1 JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.cust_id  =  T2.cust_id JOIN bank AS T3 ON T1.branch_id  =  T3.branch_id GROUP BY T2.state ORDER BY sum(acc_bal) DESC
target_sql: SELECT sum(acc_bal) AS total_balance, state FROM customer WHERE credit_score > 100 GROUP BY state ORDER BY total_balance DESC

question: What are the songs in volumes associated with the artist aged 32 or older?
failed_sql: SELECT song FROM volume WHERE artist_id  =  SELECT artist_id FROM artist WHERE age  >  32
target_sql: SELECT song FROM volume WHERE artist_id IN (SELECT Artist_ID FROM artist WHERE age >= 32)

target_sql: SELECT COUNT(*), oi.product_id FROM Orders AS o JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY oi.product_id;

question: What are the characters of actors in descending order of age?

target_sql: SELECT T1.Character FROM actor AS T1 JOIN musical AS T2 ON T1.Musical_ID = T2.Musical_ID ORDER BY T1.age DESC

question: Find out the top 10 customers by total number of orders. List customers' first and last name and the number of total orders.
